paragraphs: Shimi. Rav Adda bar Shimi; Rabbah bar Shimi; Rav Shmuel bar Shimi. [Glosses: Shimi. (1) Ketubbot 60, beginning of a: Rav Shimi bar Abaye. Perhaps it should read bar Abba; not corrected [ל״ת, provisionally “not corrected”, here and below]. Rif and Asheri have bar Ashi. (2) Nazir 50, end of b: Rav Shimi bar Adda said to Rav Pappa. Perhaps it should read bar Abba; not corrected. (3) Makkot 16a: Rav Shimi of Mahoza, and Rav objected to his words; needs examination.]
